name: Starlight Revolver
description:
About This Game

NOTICE OF END OF LIVE SERVICE

  • Starlight Re:Volver will no longer be hosted on online servers and will be offline (solo) by early December

  • Starlight Re:Volver will still be available to purchase and will continue to be available to play 

  • Starlight Re:Volver will no longer receive game updates besides major bug fixes and technical and infrastructure improvements on occasion

  • All players who purchase or purchased Starlight Re:Volver automatically unlock all dekos (cosmetics) ever made by default

---

THANK YOU - TOP 10 MOST PLAYED DEMO OF STEAM NEXT FEST

Starlight Re:Volver was #10 in the most-played demos of June 2025's Steam Next Fest 🎊

To everyone who played our game, got their friends to play, gave us feedback, and joined our community – we are so grateful 💖

ABOUT STARLIGHT RE:VOLVER

✨ Transform. Team up. Dive again and again.

Starlight Re:Volver is an action RPG in a vibrant anime world. Play as magical heroes, fight through dreamlike biomes, and discover new challenges every run.

Core Features

🏙️ A Living Anime City: Between expeditions, return to Nishi Island Metropolis to fish, craft, and hoverboard around the city.
🌠 Roguelike Elements: No two dives are the same. Unlock abilities, swap powers, and experiment with builds to shape your combat style.

🎏 Expression & Style: Collect accessories and show off your unique look!

🎶 Signature Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in nostalgic J-pop and citypop, featuring Sarah Bonito (Kero Kero Bonito), IRyS, LilyPichu, and more.
short_desc: Starlight Re:Volver is an action RPG set in a vibrant anime world. Transform into one of four magical heroes, express your style with accessories, and go fishing and crafting in the city.
